target.title: fix: avoid model-not-found fallback on OpenRouter image-input 404s
target.body:
Closes #99078

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users sending image input through an OpenRouter route could see missing-model fallback behavior when OpenRouter returned `HTTP 404: No endpoints found that support image input`. The model may exist; the rejected part is the image payload/capability, so treating it as `model_not_found` can produce misleading diagnostics and fallback decisions.

## Why This Change Was Made

The failover classifier now recognizes image-input unsupported wording as a format/capability mismatch and preserves that classification through the HTTP 404 branch. Existing OpenRouter missing-model wording such as `No endpoints found for deepseek/deepseek-r1:free` still classifies as `model_not_found`.

## User Impact

OpenRouter image-capability rejections no longer masquerade as missing models. Users and operators get behavior aligned with the actual failure: the request included image input the selected route cannot accept, while real missing-model errors still trigger the existing model-not-found handling.

## Evidence

Before fix proof:

```text
FAIL src/agents/failover-error.test.ts > failover-error > does not classify OpenRouter image-input no-endpoints 404s as model_not_found
AssertionError: expected 'model_not_found' to be 'format'

resolveFailoverReasonFromError({
  status: 404,
  message: "No endpoints found that support image input",
})
```

After fix proof:

```text
node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "import { resolveFailoverReasonFromError } from './src/agents/failover-error.js'; const cases = [['image-input unsupported 404', { status: 404, message: 'HTTP 404: No endpoints found that support image input' }], ['true missing-model no-endpoints 404', { status: 404, message: 'No endpoints found for deepseek/deepseek-r1:free.' }], ['error-object image-input unsupported 404', new Error('HTTP 404: No endpoints found that support image input')]]; for (const [label, input] of cases) { console.log(label + ': ' + resolveFailoverReasonFromError(input)); }"

image-input unsupported 404: format
true missing-model no-endpoints 404: model_not_found
error-object image-input unsupported 404: format
```

Focused and full regression tests:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/live-model-errors.test.ts src/agents/failover-error.test.ts

Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  95 passed (95)
```

Proof limitation: I did not run a live OpenRouter request because no OpenRouter credential is available in this environment. The terminal probe above exercises the same runtime classification helper that consumes provider error objects after OpenRouter has returned those HTTP 404 messages, and it covers both the image-capability rejection and the true missing-model sibling invariant requested by review.

Additional checks:

```text
pnpm exec oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-helpers/errors.ts src/agents/live-model-errors.test.ts src/agents/failover-error.test.ts
git diff --check
python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
```
